context: Centralize the unavailable-shell policy behind a helper that distinguishes supported Windows absence from contract violations. Unit-test the policy by monkeypatching os.name/CI inputs and posix_shell() without depending on the host shell. Keep the probe script's bash-specific features unchanged.
description: The verified-shell resolver correctly rejects the Windows WSL launcher and /bin/sh implementations that cannot execute the bashisms used by workflow fragments. However skip_without_posix_shell() and requires_posix_shell() currently turn a resolver regression into a green skip even on Linux/macOS, where repository CI is required to provide bash. Preserve a narrow skip only for Windows hosts with no verified Git-for-Windows bash; fail with an actionable message on POSIX and in CI environments where bash is part of the runner contract.

anti_patterns.dont: Apply a module-level skip to mixed test modules
anti_patterns.instead: Retain call-site granularity for shell-executing helpers.
anti_patterns.why: That would hide YAML and regex assertions that require no shell.

anti_patterns.dont: Relax the probe to POSIX sh syntax
anti_patterns.instead: Keep the bash capability probe and change only the no-shell disposition.
anti_patterns.why: The tested workflow fragments use set -o pipefail and here-strings.

preserves.behavior: /bin/sh or dash remains rejected because workflow fragments require bash semantics.
Windows contributors without Git Bash may skip only shell-executing tests, not unrelated tests.

verifications.description: Representative workflow shell-contract tests still execute

work_units.notes: Cover Windows/no shell -> pytest.skip, POSIX/no shell -> pytest.fail or RuntimeError, and CI/no required shell -> fail.
work_units.summary: Add host-independent tests for skip versus fail-closed policy

work_units.notes: requires_posix_shell and skip_without_posix_shell must agree; error text must identify BENCHBOX_TEST_POSIX_SHELL.
work_units.summary: Implement the explicit unavailable-shell policy in both helper APIs
Run resolver tests and representative workflow shell-contract tests
